DISCLAIMERS:

1 The overall odds of winning a prize varies upon the number of spots selected.

2 Prizes will be pari-mutuel when the total prize for matching 5/5 with 20X multiplier drawn is above $200,000. The total prize shall be split into equal shares, one share for each winning $1.00 played, rounded down to the nearest dollar. The prize amount per winner is the prize amount per share times the bet amount.

3 5/10/45 can be played seven days a week with the first draw time at 4:15 AM Arizona time. Players have until 11:14:59 PM Arizona time on each day to purchase 5/10/45 tickets. The last drawing for 5/10/45 will be each day at 11:15 PM Arizona time.

4 Lottery numbers broadcasted on television or radio, published on the Arizona State Lottery website, or published and/or communicated by other means does not constitute an official representation of the actual winning lottery numbers. The Arizona State Lottery official audited records of numbers drawn will determine the winning numbers for any draw. A draw game prize must be claimed within 180 days of a drawing.

5 All sales are final. Drawing game tickets cannot be voided.

howToPlay:
HOW TO PLAY
5/10/45
Step 1,
Pick Your Numbers

Select the number of spots you would like to play. Choose Quick Pick and let the computer select the numbers for you, or select your own:

Up to five numbers (1 – 45)

Add Bullseye to increase your odds of winning or add Super Bonus to multiply your prize.

Step 2,
Buy Your Ticket

Quick Draw tickets start at $1 per game and can be purchased3 at more than 3,000 Arizona Lottery Retailers.

Step 3,
Check Your Winnings

After the drawing occurs, match the numbers on your ticket to the winning numbers4 selected to see if you won!
